enabled.description: The power stage: off, the motor turns freely and loses its position

velocity.description: Turns the motor, for the deadman time unless rewritten

stop.description: Stops the motor, which holds where it stopped

current.description: The current scale, 0..31: (n + 1)/32 of full scale

openLoad.description: Unreliable at standstill and at speed

resets.description: Times the chip lost power since boot

holdCurrent.description: rms, at standstill; at most the run current

microsteps.description: Per full step, a power of 2

stealthChopMax.description: Full steps/s above which spreadCycle takes over; 0: never

deadman.description: A velocity not renewed for this long stops

chopper.description: spreadCycle's timing, in the datasheet's units
chopper.label: Chopper

toff.description: Off time; 1 only with tbl 2 or more

value.description: Last read, or written for a write-only register

write.description: Writes the register; bits a setting or the motion owns follow them again on the next tick

map.description: The registers and their fields, as JSON: for a register editor
